body:
Currently we have this paragraph:

> PQC implementations must be in line with [FIPS-203](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/203/ipd)/[204](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/204/ipd)/[205](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/205/ipd) as there is minimal hardened code nor implementation reference yet. https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2024/08/nist-releases-first-3-finalized-post-quantum-encryption-standards

This seems broken:

- "as there is minimal hardened code nor implementation reference yet" → I think we are missing a negation in the first part os the sentence.
- dangling naked link
- "PQC implementations must be in line with … as there is …" → I'm not sure the relation of causality between the two parts is very well formulated.
title: PQC paragraph in ASVS 5.0 seems broken
